title: John's banjo fame, move to New York and Oliver
summary: John became popular on banjo with many students, appeared in Pierron's band, and went to New York with King Oliver and Paul Barnes.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Did you ever hear John, your brother John say anything if he liked guitar better than banjo? Or which one he liked best or thought was best in the band?

Well I think John liked the banjo. Yeah cause he made more hit with the banjo. Good guitar player but he got more popular with the banjo. When banjo come out he got more popular. And he had a lot of scholars white and colored. Girls and boys.
When did he leave for New York? How long was he here?
Well John left for New York. Let me see. I live in that street.
Has he been up there 10 years or 2 or 3 years before he died?

Oh yeah been up there long before he died. Long time. Yeah he didn't, he didn't, John was up there he couldn't make it down here for my brother's funeral. Yeah he been in a good world before, 3 years before he died.
Well do you know, when did he go with Pierron? He was in one picture I have he's playing with Arlen Pierron's band.
He was, also Salmon was with Pierron too.

You didn't know that did you? I don't remember, usually John Lindsay was playing bass or somebody else, he was playing combo too. Yeah yeah. I saw John's picture with Pierron, he didn't go to New York with Pierron did he? No. Early in the 20's to make it.
But he went to New York with King Joe Oliver.
Oh he was up there with Oliver.
Him and Paul Bones too. Yeah.
At that time about 1929 or something like that. Yeah.
